selection_history.reason: Gate 1 (endpoint-compliance validation of the qualifier-rewrite codec) failed against the real pinned OpenDNP3 production master: TypedCommandHeader::ApplySelectResponse silently declines to select any point when the response header carries more indexed objects (2) than the master's own request header held (1). Not an ASIC limit; the real master correctly refuses a wire construction that doesn't match what it sent. Evidence: defense4/timing/framework/size/case4_qualifier_rewrite.py, defense4/timing/framework/size/endpoint_gate/context_evidence_qualifier_01/.

Pre-committed fallback in SELECTED_PATTERN.md's original text, triggered by Option A's gate-1 failure. Cleanest measured leakage of any option scored (MI = 0 exactly). Newly surfaced cost: unlike Option A, Option B needs insertion on READ (49B->58B) in addition to SELECT/OPERATE (37B->58B) -- READ was free under Option A and is not free under B. Hardware feasibility of this on all three roles is a follow-up, not yet closed.

pattern.description: Single uniform 58-byte padded TCP payload for READ, SELECT, OPERATE responses; no split.
pattern.mechanism: in-stream insertion / deparser constant-filler padding (mechanism choice not yet finalized -- see follow-up hardware-feasibility task)

READ.transform_required: pad response +9 application-consistent bytes to reach 58B -- NEW requirement, not needed under the superseded Option A

SELECT.transform_required: pad response +21 bytes to reach 58B via the existing proven separate-header insertion codec (case4_padding.expand_control-style; the qualifier-rewrite codec is NOT used for this option)

OPERATE.status: not_yet_implemented; OPERATE's native 37B is itself inferred from SELECT symmetry, not physically measured

rejected_options.A: qualifier-rewrite codec fails real-master endpoint-compliance validation -- see selection_history
rejected_options.A_prime: depends on production master poll configuration outside this task's authorization/access; builds no padding mechanism, under-delivering on the prompt's explicit framing of padding as a required capability
rejected_options.C: not a separate option -- a cut-point choice, moot once no splitting is used (Option B has no carve)
rejected_options.D: dominated by B: same no-split structure, smaller pad target (49B) that excludes the 58B background class as an unhidden residual; B absorbs that class for free
rejected_options.E: cheap but reintroduces the exact size-channel leak this project exists to close
